author: raman118
body:
#### References to other Issues or PRs

Fixes #24593.

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

Removed `\nobreak` from the LaTeX output of bounded `Idx` objects. This prevents the command from appearing visibly in affected Jupyter notebook renderers while preserving the index label and range.

Added regression tests for bounded and unbounded indices and updated existing indexed-expression tests.

#### Other comments

Validation:
- LaTeX printer tests: 178 passed, 2 xfailed.
- Code-quality tests: 6 passed.
- Ruff and local author checks passed.

#### AI Generation Disclosure

The contributor used OpenAI Codex to generate changes in `sympy/printing/latex.py` and `sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py` and draft this description. The exact runtime model identifier was unavailable.

#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
* printing
  * Fixed LaTeX rendering of bounded indices in notebook renderers that do not support `\nobreak`.
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

Remove nobreak from LaTeX index ranges

Preserve bounded index notation while avoiding a command unsupported by older notebook math renderers.

AI-generated changes by OpenAI Codex.

diff --git a/sympy/printing/latex.py b/sympy/printing/latex.py
index fe44b0e89ba2..7cf4169a6df6 100644
--- a/sympy/printing/latex.py
+++ b/sympy/printing/latex.py
@@ -825,7 +825,7 @@ def _print_Idx(self, expr):
                 lower = self._print(expr.lower)
             else:
                 lower = self._print(S.Zero)
-            interval = '{lower}\\mathrel{{..}}\\nobreak {upper}'.format(
+            interval = '{lower}\\mathrel{{..}}{upper}'.format(
                     lower = lower, upper = upper)
             return '{{{label}}}_{{{interval}}}'.format(
                 label = label, interval = interval)
diff --git a/sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py b/sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py
index 31bd0afc79b5..562d9eb47f45 100644
--- a/sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py
+++ b/sympy/printing/tests/test_latex.py
@@ -905,7 +905,7 @@ def test_latex_indexed():
     assert indexed_latex == r'\overline{{\Psi}_{0}} {\Psi}_{0}'
 
     # Symbol('gamma') gives r'\gamma'
-    interval = '\\mathrel{..}\\nobreak '
+    interval = r'\mathrel{..}'
     assert latex(Indexed('x1', Symbol('i'))) == r'{x_{1}}_{i}'
     assert latex(Indexed('x2', Idx('i'))) == r'{x_{2}}_{i}'
     assert latex(Indexed('x3', Idx('i', Symbol('N')))) == r'{x_{3}}_{{i}_{0'+interval+'N - 1}}'
@@ -916,6 +916,12 @@ def test_latex_indexed():
     assert latex(IndexedBase('a_b')) == r'a_{b}'
 
 
+def test_latex_Idx():
+    assert latex(Idx('j', 5)) == r'{j}_{0\mathrel{..}4}'
+    assert latex(Idx('j', (-2, 2))) == r'{j}_{-2\mathrel{..}2}'
+    assert latex(Idx('j')) == 'j'
+
+

     # regular "d" for ordinary derivatives
     assert latex(diff(x**3, x, evaluate=False)) == \

linked.author: Davide-sd
linked.body:
On Jupyter notebook I get this:

```python
from sympy import *
init_printing(use_latex=True)
j = Idx("j", 5)
j
```

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9921777/214582697-6171103c-f07c-4983-99e6-5a496cb99790.png)

```python
print(latex(j))
# {j}_{0\mathrel{..}\nobreak 4}
```
